end.summary:
Practised reading and plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane.
Used x as horizontal movement and y as vertical movement for several points.
Identified Quadrants I and III correctly from coordinate signs.
Quadrant-sign mix-ups remained for (3, −7); it was not corrected after the last attempt.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised plotting points by moving along the x-axis first and then the y-axis, and correctly explained why (2,3) and (3,2) are different points. They also correctly identified Quadrants I and III in examples. There was a mix-up with the signs for (3, −7): positive x and negative y place it in Quadrant IV, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to make a four-quadrant sign chart and place one example point in each quadrant.
